design_system.theme: Midnight Highway — full dark-theme night-driving identity: deep navy asphalt backgrounds, neon cyan and magenta glow accents, headlight amber; clearly distinct from the warm farm and khaki military candidate sites
design_system.font_strategy: Arial Black / Arial Rounded MT Bold / Trebuchet MS display fallbacks, system sans for body; no external font dependency.
signature_elements: CSS-only night highway hero scene: star field, city skyline silhouette, perspective road with animated lane dashes, swaying neon car with magenta taillight, oncoming amber headlights
Glow-based depth (soft neon glows) instead of the hard offset shadows used on the other candidate sites
Codes band with amber code chip and next-milestone note (960000 likes)
Offsale tags and price tags on the gamepass catalog table
PIL-generated og.png (1200x630) matching the night highway theme
responsive_rules: 375px: single column, full-width CTAs, hamburger nav, scene car scaled, boost chip hidden, tables scroll inside wrapper only
768px: single-column hero, two-column grids, non-sticky guide contents
1440px: 1160px content shell, two-column hero, three/four-column grids
html/body overflow-x: clip; verified scrollWidth === viewport width at 375/768/1440 on all 8 pages (24/24)
